title: Validate Spec Corpus
description: Draft command semantic instance for the repeatable USF specification validator gate.
purpose: Validate schemas, catalogues, fixtures, real semantic instances, source-import manifest checks, and validator selftests.
failureSemantics: Non-zero exit indicates blocking or error findings; the validator fails closed on unreadable input or unresolved cross-file checks.
aiGuidance: Run this gate before claiming semantic corpus completion; do not treat a generated report as higher authority than the checked artefacts.
